name: SiteDash
description: connects to the SiteDash monitoring/dashboard service for site management.
project_description:
SiteDash connects your Drupal site to SiteDash.io, providing centralized monitoring, audit reporting, and management tools. It offers secure, automated integration with no manual setup required.

 Features 
 
 Secure authentication and connection to the SiteDash.io monitoring service 
 Automatic integration with the Audit Export module for sending audit data 
 Auto-configures remote post URLs, authentication headers, and site identifiers 
 Optional override to let SiteDash manage Audit Export settings centrally 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, navigate to /admin/config/services/sitedash to enter your SiteDash token. Once authenticated, the module will configure remote post settings automatically. If enabled, the "Override Remote Post" setting allows SiteDash to manage Audit Export's remote configuration for you.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10.x or 11.x 
 Audit Export module and its submodules 
 A SiteDash.io account with an authentication token 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 This module is maintained by the SiteDash team . Visit our site to learn more or contact us for support and partnership opportunities.
